measurement_scope.input: generated accesses and branch paths, no physical graph or search
measurement_scope.first: first trace pass after allocation and preseeded occupancy
measurement_scope.reuse: second pass on the same allocated state, labels always invalidated
measurement_scope.reset_ms: explicit search reset; does not include lazy page/node initialization
measurement_scope.label_access_including_lazy_init_ms: four access passes, target set/cleanup, checksum arithmetic and lazy initialization
measurement_scope.commit_ms: original serial owner slots, reduced occupancy mirror and optional net index; excludes path materialization
measurement_scope.sync_host_pack_ms: host dirty-list packing using a synthetic price formula; no device transfer
measurement_scope.phase_sum_ms: sum of measured state phases; excludes construction, graph/search, path materialization, validation and I/O
measurement_scope.label_capacity_bytes: vector payload capacities only; excludes allocator overhead and shared design/net state
measurement_scope.diagnostics: separate instrumented runs; page miss timers perturb performance, do not use for speedup
